title: 内地客仅占13%：香港业务却强劲增长，高净值客群从何而来？
speaker: Huynh Thanh Phong

segments.en: It's just a bit more than a year since I've seen you on that view. Back here, still emotional.
segments.zh: 距上次见面刚过一年多，重回这里，依然感慨。

segments.en: And I have to say that's quite exciting with the result, as you just mentioned, triple the net profit to 172 million.
segments.zh: 正如你提到的，净利润翻了三倍，达到1.72亿美元，这令人振奋。

segments.en: This is, as we share with you last year, as we build scale over the years, this now starts to translate into cash flow and profitability for the Group.
segments.zh: 正如去年所说，随着多年规模积累，现在开始转化为集团的现金流和盈利能力。

segments.en: So we are very glad that we continue to deliver that promise. And the top line, the bottom line growth consistently in the last few quarters have been up consistently.
segments.zh: 我们很高兴能持续兑现承诺。过去几个季度，营收和利润都保持增长。

segments.en: And if you look at the trend of the Q2 of the Q1, it's even stronger. We grew by 32 percent when it comes to VNB versus the first half of 18 percent.
segments.zh: 从一季度到二季度的趋势看，增长更强劲。新业务价值增长32%，而上半年整体为18%。

segments.en: That gives you a sense of the momentum of the business. Hong Kong momentum seems to be very strong, despite from a pretty high base.
segments.zh: 这体现了业务的势头。香港市场势头强劲，尽管基数已经很高。

segments.en: That's correct. What's the outlook? For Hong Kong, I think we're quite excited about Hong Kong because this is our headquarters, and this is to us.
segments.zh: 没错。展望如何？我们对香港非常兴奋，因为这里是我们的总部。

segments.en: This is the city, the superconductor connector for the region and the work-class financial center. So people continue to come here.
segments.zh: 这座城市是区域的超级连接器，也是世界级金融中心，所以人们持续涌入。

segments.en: Case in point, I can share with you, for example, our high net worth business, which has a very strong start, that's the beauty private.
segments.zh: 举个例子，我们的高净值业务开局强劲，即富卫私人业务。

segments.en: But if you look at that high net worth business, we are attracting people from Hong Kong, Singapore, and the mutant globally, it's not just about mainland Chinese coming visiting Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 高净值业务吸引来自香港、新加坡及全球的客户，不仅仅是内地访客。

segments.en: So if you look at how mainland Chinese visiting Hong Kong, we're talking about 13 percent of total VNB for the Group. So the diversification of the market, the diversification of customer base and distribution channels certainly give us that benefit.
segments.zh: 内地访客贡献仅占集团新业务价值的13%。市场、客户群和渠道的多元化带来了优势。
